review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty („“) and cites no clause; the claim that the application was submitted 'only later' is correct, but the proposal text invents 'ეროვნული ბანკის წინასწარი თანხმობის მოლოდინში' as a status and rewrites M-002 as not yet in use, which contradicts the register's own 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021'.
review_comment: Document states M-002 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021' while 'განაცხადი წარდგენილია 10.08.2021, განხილვის პროცესშია', i.e. used without prior consent, which conflicts with 'წინასწარ თანხმობას'. The verdict matches the gold; the empty evidence quote is a defect, and the proposal rewrites the register entry to a state that is not factual instead of requiring a stop/limit of use and the internal validation.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation says 'განუსაზღვრელი ვადის' (indefinite period), but the regulation says NBG 'განუსაზღვრავს ვადას (მინიმუმ 6 თვე)' i.e. NBG sets a term of at least 6 months; rationale says the duty arises 'after obtaining status' while the regulation puts the duty during the term set for achieving compliance and applying for consent.
review_comment: The obligation garbles 'განუსაზღვრავს ვადას' (sets a deadline) into 'განუსაზღვრელი ვადა' (indefinite term), and it is an NBG-triggered, case-specific process duty that a model register would not contain. The gold concerns M-002 consent and validation, not this paragraph.

The duty to document model theory/structure belongs to model development documentation; document.txt is an inventory (it lists 'მეთოდი' per model only). The system itself notes it is a register, so a gap here is not meaningful, and adding a theory section to a register is misplaced.

'სათანადო დოკუმენტირება' at the build stage is a development-process duty; a model register is not where build documentation lives. The system admits 'დოკუმენტი არის მოდელების ჩამონათვალი', so flagging it as a gap is a scope error.
Data suitability and quality assessment for model building is documented in development files, not in an inventory. The system acknowledges 'რეესტრი', so the gap finding is out of scope.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation drops the first sentence's purpose but is otherwise faithful; the proposal's 'დაემატა ... სავალდებულო კომპონენტები' mirrors policy text, not register content.
review_comment: How the internal validation process defines limits and assumptions is a validation-methodology duty; the register only records dates ('ბოლო ვალიდაცია'). Flagging absence of process description in an inventory is not a real gap.

review_unsupported_claims: Misses that the register shows third-party models with weaker treatment (M-005 validation only 'მომწოდებლის დოკუმენტაციის მიმოხილვა', M-007 'არ ჩატარებულა – მიღებულია მომწოდებლის ვალიდაციის ანგარიში', M-005 'ალტერნატიული გეგმა: არ არსებობს'); proposal adds 'მესაკუთრეობის, ტესტირებისა და მუდმივი მონიტორინგის' content not in the regulation sentence.
review_comment: 'უფრო მკაცრ სტანდარტებს' is a general policy-level standard that a register cannot state; the 'none' finding is out of scope. The register's own entries (M-007 'არ ჩატარებულა') would be the real evidence of non-compliance, which the system did not identify.

Monitoring of identifiable bias in data processing ('გადახრის მონიტორინგი') is an operational process duty; a model inventory does not carry it. Also the provision is dated 2022-05-03, after this 2021-era register, so its absence is not a gap.
